notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed settings UI (Very high was actually very low). Resolution still will not apply depending on your monitor as it is windowed full-screen.
- Removed static mesh bone that I left on cafeteria tray (this was just a mesh but didn't want it confusing people and just forgot it there)
- Fixed when getting revived would slightly sprint while crawling and fixed if you died while crouched you would never actually be crawling and sort of just be crouched despite being in the crawl state. Also in this state you would move at a speed of 150 as oppose to 50 even though you were downed.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]NEW IN DEPTH IN GAME GUIDE[/h2]
- Added a full guide in the in game pause menu along with the loading screen guide to further help players. I have noticed the biggest problem is some players did not know what to do and never even banished the first bone (the game basically starts once this is done)

[h2]BUG FIX[/h2]
- Fixed a odd bug where Charlie would get stuck, added a odd interval check to ensure he does not get stuck anywhere else and if he does he will eventually fix himself (shouldn't happen but just incase I missed any odd collisions)
- Edited VOIP variables to reduce cutting out of VOIP.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content: - Fixed multiplayer bug not allowing players to join very rarely as steam netdriver would load after voip driver.
